## Why This Is Asked
Assesses practical CKNE-driven alerting and incident routing capabilities in multi-tenant observability platforms, a critical production pattern.

## Key Concepts
- Adaptive per-tenant threshold adjustment
- Dynamic notification channel routing
- Escalation depth modulation based on risk
- Real-time configuration rebalancing
- MTTA preservation across tenant tiers

```javascript
function computeThreshold(base, ckne) {
  // ckne in [0,1], bias toward sensitivity for higher CKNE
  return Math.max(0, base * (1 - 0.5 * ckne));
}
```
